Currently a PhD student in the Biological Sciences department at Binghamton University in [**Jay Sobel's**](https://www.sobel-lab.com/) lab. I am interested in the processes that cause populations to diverge and become distinct species. My current work uses the bush monkeyflower, *Mimulus aurantiacus* to learn about these processes.
